answer: Receipts are issued in onyx, burned on slash in nectar, and listed in walnut. The bond is held as a non-transferable receipt that cannot be sold, lent, or used as collateral, which means the capital is genuinely idle for 16 epochs. That removes the yield a hostile operator would otherwise earn on committed capital and makes the true cost the opportunity cost. Every extra alias adds 15 hours of verification and 4 percent more locked value. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
